scope: Independent Track C subagent review of root LD diagnostic code; no root files edited

scientific_review.exact_allelic_join: Appropriate: source chrom/pos/ref/alt, source identity checks, exact LD index match, no rsID joins
scientific_review.orientation: Appropriate: source ALT effect and documented LD ALT coding; multiplier+1; no fit-driven flips
scientific_review.matrix_reconstruction: Appropriate conditional on separately documented original upper-triangle representation: add transpose, restore original diagonal, preserve raw triangle
scientific_review.scaling: Transparent candidate Gram-to-correlation derivation, source G retained and scientific scaling compatibility not asserted
scientific_review.ordering: Unique sorted LD indices bound to ordered table hash; extraction uses same index sequence
scientific_review.inference_firewall: No fine-mapping, PIP, credible-set, posterior variant probabilities or effect fitting; scalar null-covariance mismatch objective is descriptive compatibility diagnostic
scientific_review.failures: No PSD projection, eigenvalue clipping or numerical ridge applied to matrix; sampled-eigenvalue optimization denominator shift is diagnostic-only parameter, not replacement LD

recommendations_sent_to_root.finding: Extraction currently lacks explicit same-chromosome / within-10Mb bandwidth assertion. Current six C intervals are each <3.25Mb, so no observed locus violation. Bind checks to extraction receipt.

PASS_NUMERICS_ONLY checks PSD/symmetry/range; numerical rank, conditioning and null-space compatibility are reported but not included in that status. Add explicit rank-deficiency and condition-warning flags, preserve singular-support interpretation as unresolved if applicable.

Bounded scalar minimization plus endpoint comparisons is descriptive numerical optimization; it does not by itself certify a global optimum in arbitrary multimodal objectives. Report optimizer outcome and avoid implying a calibrated universal clearance threshold.
